# P0 — Universelle technische Durchsetzung: Weiterarbeiten bis zur verifizierten Wirkung

**Principal/Code Owner:** Ingolf Lohmann · **gez. ilo.** · 19.11.2026

## Bindender Owner-Auftrag
> Die universelle technische Durchsetzung der Verarbeitungsregel soll in QIK-VRT mithilfe von EAP und EMP nachweisbar und beweisbar persistiert sein und angewendet werden, so dass diese technische Umsetzung nicht verloren geht! DoD. QED. — gez. ilo.

**Generalität:** Jede **im QIK-VRT-Execution-Plane registrierte** Work-Unit, jedes EAP-/EMP-koordinierte Folgeereignis und jeder angeschlossene Terminal-/Browser-/Agent-/MCP-Consumer, unabhängig vom Sachgebiet. Kein nur auf Gateway, DevOps oder einen Client begrenzter Sonderfall. Fremde ChatGPT-/KI-Plattformen können nur durch tatsächliche Adapter-Adoption plus Host-seitige Mediationskontrolle einbezogen werden; eine gespeicherte QIK-VRT-Policy allein erzwingt keine Kontrolle über fremde Systeme.

## Live Source Diagnosis (Authority exact HEAD 42a538789d07b9ab48fdbd1471ad3067fbb34989)
- **Bereits vorhanden, nicht ersetzen:** `policy/HUMAN_MACHINE_PROGRESS_PROTOCOL.json#/client_continuation/work_completion`; `tools/ai_handoff.py --client-receipt`; `state/work_units/QIKVRT_GOAL_BOUND_CONTINUATION_REPAIR_20261102_V1.json`; `src/qikvrt_effect_ack.py` und `src/qikvrt_effect_ack_wire.py`; `state/autonomy/AUTONOMOUS_SELF_HEALING_CONTRACT_V1.json`; `state/autonomy/WORKFLOW_EXECUTOR_MESH_CONTRACT_V1.json` und Watchdog. Keine neue Parallelsteuerung.
- **Exakte Lücke:** Policy-Feld `external_platform_enforcement_or_universal_adoption=false`. Work-unit-Validator checkt deklarierte Korrespondenz; allein weder aktuelle Providerwahrheit noch automatische Geltung in allen Consumers nachgewiesen. EAP-Kern ist pure State Machine und authentifiziert Quellen nicht selbst. EMP-gesteuerte tatsächliche Execution/ACK-Bindung fehlt in dem hier überprüften End-to-End-Wirkungsnachweis.
- **Aktive Kette:** Open-Draft Review-Handoff PR #762 / Issue #761, Voll-CI und Originalhost-Zulassung separat. Nicht vorzeitig MERGE/DONE behaupten. Owner-Stop-Regel in Issue #758 verbietet bei offenem Exact-HEAD-CI weitere blind generierte Code-/Manifest-Commits. Historisches Bootstrap-Control `active_writer_lease=false`; Originalhost HTTP 525 und native `ready=false`.

## Soll-Invariante, geschlossene Semantik
For each `work_unit_id` with immutable `principal_id`, `goal_sha256`, `acceptance_sha256`, `scope` and source revision, the enforcement boundary **must deny terminal DONE** if any of the following are unresolved:
1. **Complete dynamic inventory** of original work and all causally required successors/dependencies (Issues, PRs, workflows, independent effects and EAP/EMP work units) with cursor exhaustion, same exact HEAD/TREE, no lost pages or duplicates, externally verified current inventory digest.
2. Any required work still `OPEN`, `ACTIVE`, `BLOCKED` or `UNKNOWN` — including a quiet runner with pending work. A task's GitHub `closed` or a workflow `completed/success` never substitutes for effect acceptance.
3. Pending/in-progress execution, retry reconciliation, unknown/ambiguous external effect, missing reviewer/admission evidence, expired/fenced writer lease where an effecting writer is required, staleness or manifest/HEAD drift.
4. Missing authenticated, original-byte-validated EAP wire chain, missing independent target-effect readback, mismatched goal/acceptance/HEAD/source identity, `TRANSPORT_ACK` only, or an EAP state other than `EFFECT_ACK_DONE`.
5. Missing witness of **actual native consumer application** of the gate. Self-report, policy text, proof-of-concept, source commit, mock, plugin installation, static mirror and automation schedule do not independently establish deployment/application.

`DONE(w) -> GoalSatisfied(w) AND CompleteInventory(w) AND AllRequiredSuccessorsClosed(w) AND IndependentEAP(w) AND AppliedEnforcement(w)`. The guard MUST be checked at the actual terminal effect/closure path, not merely in an advisory dashboard.

**State semantics:** `CONTINUATION_REQUIRED` is durable, never silently converted to `DONE`; `HOLD/UNKNOWN` is explicit and records causal blocker/next admitted action. `PASS` for code or CI is not `DONE` for the user's requested external effect. Only an original, independently verified `EFFECT_ACK_DONE` **for the same goal** allows terminal release. On context or client change, original work identity, acceptance scope, explicit delegation and continuation obligations are retained.

## Required enforcement points / ownership
1. **Ingress:** principal request becomes immutable goal-bound Work-Unit/EMP record with root-work ID, intended effect, rights/risk boundaries, scope, dynamic dependency inventory, actor/delegation and source hash. Privacy/ACL apply to sources — do not publicly export confidential records.
2. **Execution:** one existing trusted EMP coordinator chooses next executable successor, locks exactly one admitted writer where needed, binds monotone fencing, expiry and Exact-HEAD CAS; read-only tasks do not require a repository writer. When blocked on external permission, retain OPEN and continue other admissible dependencies; never create new bot-commit loops.
3. **EAP:** validate the pinned original wire-03 chain and independent receipt/readback using existing adapter; do not simply accept a caller-supplied `effect_ack_done=true`.
4. **Closure:** central server-side/runner-enforced gate re-reads fresh complete inventory and causal edges, then atomically prevents `DONE` without identical verified goal, scope, no open descendants, EAP and consumer admission. Clients may display the state but may not override it.
5. **Persistence:** append-only, replayable event/claim journal with stable IDs, hash-chain predecessor binding, create-only original intents, expected previous ref/epoch, readback receipt and exact Source/Execution/Effect versions. Restart and same-writer re-entry must be idempotent. Mirror/peer adoption requires per-node independent ACK and applied version; registry-derived, no fixed mirror list.
6. **Universal API:** versioned `GET capabilities`, `GET work-units/:id`, `GET receipts/:id`, `POST admitted-effect` (only under writer/EMP authorization); a read-only external Q&A/MCP consumer can inspect status but cannot issue EAP DONE.
7. **Repository integration:** integrate by extending the EXISTING `tools/ai_handoff.py` + policy and original EAP/EMP consumer/Watcher paths, not as a competing scheduler. Exact-head test, original provenance, code-owner review and independent native host admission required.

## Review candidate and negative test bundle, prepared 19.11.2026
An **unmerged, offline pure-Python review candidate** with explicit provider/EAP verification callbacks was prepared and tested using synthetic adapters. The code is not tracked on Main/PR and is not claimed deployed or attested by a live provider. It is not a replacement EAP implementation.
- Local candidate module `qikvrt_universal_completion_gate.py` and `test_qikvrt_universal_completion_gate.py`: **24 unit tests PASS** offline, including exhaustive 2^6 negative-condition finite model and dynamic inventory 2501 units. This is **finite software testing**, not Lean/kernel universal proof.
- Named negative vectors: inventory incomplete/403, missing actual inventory verifier, duplicate work items, open or unknown descendants, live CI run, missing readback, transport ACK instead of EAP, receipt-work/goal/acceptance/head mismatch, failed independent EAP verifier, stale HEAD, missing effecting writer, schema drift; read-only goals remain exempt from writer lease. All must fail closed.
- Candidate source code/README are available as an independently downloadable review bundle in the originating interaction; **GitHub-hosted source artifact is NOT yet published or mirrored**. Its exact SHA-256 and full bytes must be independently checked again from the eventual admitted repository commit before calling it integrated. Only source-bound GitHub bytes and a native run establish integrated regression results.

## Formal proof obligations (not yet discharged)
- **Safety S1:** for every *admitted closure transition* the gate is non-bypassable and all independent EAP/goal/causal-inventory predicates held at the same tested version.
- **Safety S2:** no mere `TRANSPORT_ACK`, comment, approval, workflow success, commit or unverified client boolean can grant `DONE`.
- **Safety S3:** denied/incomplete/stale inventory or writer-admission results never cause silent terminality.
- **Safety S4:** original root goal/acceptance/claim and causal successor identity cannot drift across restart/merge/context change.
- **Liveness L1 (conditional):** with fair scheduling, admitted executor, available trusted provider and finitely resolvable dependency graph, actionable obligations can make progress. Under permanent 403/525 or unavailable runtime, no unconditional liveness theorem or false completion claim.
- Formalize abstract finite-state version in existing Lean/mathlib lane, pin exact axioms, review independent replay/vectors, validate full native kernel and integration. A Lean theorem about an abstract model does **not** prove deployment or real-world progress.

## Definition of Done · QED
Only after independent evidence of (a) code/manifest and mandatory regression tests on exact HEAD, (b) live application at each declared entrypoint of the **existing** terminal/consumer (including restart/fencing/replay), (c) a demonstrably blocked premature DONE in a real test and a demonstrably permitted DONE with authentic fresh EAP, (d) native CI/review/admitted Main, (e) originalhost HTTPS/mTLS, (f) browser plus independent artificial client, (g) per-node adoption acknowledgements where claimed, and (h) independent effect ACK journal.

Until then `PRINCIPAL_AUTHORIZED=true`, `CONTINUATION_REQUIRED=true`, `UNIVERSAL_ENFORCEMENT_VERIFIED=false`, `EFFECT_ACK_DONE=false`. Keep following dynamic open work through existing workbench; **do not substitute this issue for executed source or a tested release**.

**Principal authorization:** DoD / QED. gez. ilo.
